vocabulary.simpleKo: 많은 사람들이 가지고 싶어 하거나 원한다는 뜻이에요.
달팽이 등에 있는 끈적끈적하고 미끄러운 액체예요.
어떤 것이 그만큼의 가치가 있다는 뜻이에요.
무언가를 보고 생각이나 느낌을 얻게 된 상태예요.

explanations.title: desired 뜻
explanations.easyEnglish: Desired means wanted by many people.
explanations.textKo: desired은/는 '원하는, 갖고 싶어 하는'라는 뜻이에요. 본문에서는 'wanted by many people'라는 의미로 쓰였어요.
examples: This dye was the rarest and most desired color in ancient times.

explanations.title: slime 뜻
explanations.easyEnglish: Slime is a sticky, slippery liquid.
explanations.textKo: slime은/는 '점액, 끈적한 액체'라는 뜻이에요. 본문에서는 'a sticky, slippery liquid'라는 의미로 쓰였어요.
examples: People needed the slime of the Murex snail.

explanations.title: worth 뜻
explanations.easyEnglish: Worth means having the value of something.
explanations.textKo: worth은/는 '~의 가치가 있는'라는 뜻이에요. 본문에서는 'having a value of'라는 의미로 쓰였어요.
examples: It was worth even more than gold.

explanations.title: robes 뜻
explanations.textKo: robes은/는 '긴 겉옷, 예복'라는 뜻이에요. 본문에서는 'long, loose clothes'라는 의미로 쓰였어요.
examples: The top officials of the Roman Empire wore robes with a purple stripe.

explanations.title: royal 뜻
explanations.easyEnglish: Royal means related to kings, queens, or emperors.
explanations.textKo: royal은/는 '왕실의, 왕의'라는 뜻이에요. 본문에서는 'related to a king, queen, or emperor'라는 의미로 쓰였어요.
examples: Thus, the dye was also called royal purple.

explanations.title: inspired 뜻
explanations.easyEnglish: Inspired means given an idea or feeling by something.
explanations.textKo: inspired은/는 '영감을 받은'라는 뜻이에요. 본문에서는 'given an idea or feeling to do something'라는 의미로 쓰였어요.
examples: Artists and designers today are often inspired by this color.

explanations.title: luxurious 뜻
explanations.easyEnglish: Luxurious means very expensive, beautiful, and comfortable.
explanations.textKo: luxurious은/는 '고급스러운, 호화로운'라는 뜻이에요. 본문에서는 'very comfortable, expensive, and beautiful'라는 의미로 쓰였어요.
examples: They use it in their works to make things look more luxurious.
